changes.details: Realtime input increments a local draft revision on every edit. A valid acknowledgement clears text only if the captured submitted revision is still current; A-to-B-to-A is preserved. Existing owner and input-blocking fences prevent late/invalid/failed acknowledgements from clearing a replacement draft or replaying a frame.

ExecutionForm wraps submitted controls in disabled submission-fields while busy and uses a synchronous submit latch. Errors unlock the fields and retain selections; keyed turn/scope ownership prevents an old response from modifying a new editor.

Queue and goal editors lock their submitted fields and cancel action while pending, reject synchronous duplicate submit, and retain text on failure. Queue failure uses real Api unknown-operation behavior in regression tests: text unlocks while mutation controls remain fenced. Goal begin/cancel cannot replace the pending snapshot.

additionalFindings.title: A delayed queue refresh unmounted unsaved sibling queue editors
additionalFindings.discovery: During TaskPanel fix verification, two queue rows were edited and only the first saved. Its success refreshed usePaged, which clears items while fetching. With a real asynchronous refresh gap, the second editor unmounted and its local draft disappeared. An immediately resolved stub masked the unmount through batching.

originalReproduction.result: 1 test passed by asserting the existing draft loss before the additional fix

additionalFindings.fix: Moved queue draft ownership into QueuePanel without changing usePaged. The cache is scoped by a keyed thread/epoch owner, capped at 32 drafts, 1,000,000 aggregate characters and 100,000 per draft. Draft object identity guards submitted cleanup. While the current directory is unavailable or no longer contains a drafted entry, its text remains visible in an explicit retained-draft section without stale operation controls. Saving remains gated on a fresh successful list. Cache size/character bounds and cross-owner isolation are tested.

testDevelopmentNotes: The first additional queue-cache limit fixture duplicated 100,000-character strings in both text and native input, hitting the existing directory response bound before editing. The fixture was corrected to load short rows and grow drafts through UI edits; final tests pass.
An earlier tsc run encountered the concurrently edited modal-mutations test exact option; it was fixed by its owning agent, and final tsc passes.
coordination: Only the six listed source/test files were changed by this agent. Parent owns the shared fieldset.submission-fields CSS reset. Historical round6 audit evidence and coverage were not updated. No global source snapshot or audit gate was refreshed during fixes.
limitations: Tests used local jsdom and intercepted/stubbed service responses; no native/external service, personal credential or paid invocation.
No full suite, production build, deployment or migration was run; parent coordinates the final UI build after all agents stop writing.
Queue drafts are bounded in-memory state of the current queue panel owner; this fix does not add persistent storage across closing the panel or changing thread/epoch.
